items.name: Bremium Cubing 2026
items.information:
As always, we are happy to welcome a lot of competitors at the fifth edition of Bremium Cubing!


Wir freuen uns über zahlreiche Anmeldungen für die fünfte Ausgabe der Bremium Cubing!

items.name: Ohio State Mental Madness 2026

organisers.name: The Rubik's Cube Club at Ohio State

venue.name: [Ohio Union, The Ohio State University](https://ohiounion.osu.edu)
venue.details: First Floor - Great Hall Meeting Room

items.information:
#### This competition only features 3x3x3 Fewest Moves

As a result, this competition is not recommended for those looking for a typical competition experience. However, new competitors are still welcome to sign up :)
Please consider instead any of the many [other competitions happening in Ohio](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list).

All competitors who attend will receive a special "I Survived Ohio State Mental Madness 2026" pen.
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTUyODk5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4254cb13a69ed1ff2b2a9e402f4260ca98221e4f/IMG_4350.png)

**Unofficial Event Info**
This competition will also feature an unofficial Linear FMC Head-to-Head Bracket. More information and the sign-up link can be found on the Unofficial Event tab.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDkzMzQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9ca9e8fcab1e8527310fb042346ed6e2b4e8784a/image.png)

items.name: Arkansas Championship 2026
items.information:
This competition is supported by [Southern Cubing](https://southerncubing.com/) as the Arkansas State Championship for 2026!

While only residents of Arkansas are eligible for the title of Arkansas State Champion, all competitors are welcome and encouraged to compete! More information can be found on the [Arkansas Champion Titles](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArkansasChampionship2025#52514-arkansas-champion-titles) tab.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTUxMjY0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ba8cf400c90970b89cbba5cfb8075de64f93272e/image.png)

To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTA5ODQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d90b474725899b23c9c5d15d90dc03063159a03c/southernCubing.png)
